notes.title: So, What's Happening?; Final Update of 2022.
notes.notes:
[h2]Trailer + Release Date News[/h2]
The original trailer for this game was completed in July, and was supposed to release a week or two before the release date of the game.

This is still the plan, but due to the fact that making a video game takes longer than I plan, that trailer will not be the ONLY trailer to release for the game. I will hopefully put together a smaller, more teaser-y trailer with unseen-ish gameplay, and release it before the end of the year.
In terms of the release date, it's very clearly not going to come out before 2023, and I will say right now: [b]the release date for the game will not be announced until, at the very least, the exact month it releases.[/b] And as of now until then, assume the game will release in 2050, as that is the only accurate release window for the game.

[h2]Website + Actual Game News[/h2]
There is also some news that I have yet to announce on steam!
I rebuilt from scratch, the entire website for the game, https://replanted.whistleblowerstudios.com/ is now up, operational, and has a bunch of news that I have yet to publish anywhere else.
The game itself is also being worked on, as it always has been, what I've been working on mostly is the Police mechanic, that I detailed a while ago. It's about finished, with the exception of the questioning/interrogation mechanics, I still need to write all 11 days worth of dialogue for those parts, after that's all done, I'll add the rest of the NPCs that need to be added, then a bunch of secrets and stuff. The farming mechanic also will have a slight rework, and I'll get to that soon.
Since last time, I also built the maps/levels for every dream currently ingame.

[h2]New Teaser[/h2]

notes.title: Progress Update: April 11th, 2022.
notes.notes:
Last update was in October, why was that? Because I was working on a prologue for the game, near halfway through the development, I realized how much of a spoiler it was for the actual game, and I couldn't release it. The problem is that I wanted the game to be a surprise, so it was never announced. This, of course, led to a drought of updates, so I wanted to make up for that by having a full news post that goes in-depth into the actual game and it's mechanics.

[h1]As the days go by...[/h1]

I did some polling on my [url=https://discord.gg/CXT4AMug]discord[/url] to finetune some mechanics in the game. And one of the ones I did a poll on was [b][i]time.[/i][/b] A 43-6 vote decided on there being 10 days with unique interactions with NPCs (with each day being 2 hours, aside from sleeping). This segues nicely into our next topic, the sleeping mechanic. 

The game will allow you to go to sleep (and dream) whenever nightfall comes, otherwise, you wont be tired! For convenience, the script is listed here (with a placeholder for the tp to dream)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827996/1d1fcd809726f932f8d848c2112c6acc8e5764d5.png[/img] 
This also brings me to the dreaming mechanic, and for that I'd like you, the steam community, to help. How do you think dreams should be selected? Let me explain.

The game has multiple unique dreams, but exactly how they'll be selected (to be shown to you) is still up for decision. 
Should they be selected based on what night it is? Or on how many dreams you've already dreamt?
Having the dream based on the current night would make some dreams inaccessible if you miss them, but also make it easier to understand. Having the dream based on the amount of times you've slept would make no dream inaccessible, but may be a bit more confusing for some players. 
Again, I leave it up to you to help me decide on what it should be.

That's enough about sleep before I put you to sleep. Lets talk police. The police in this game are controlled partially by RNG. If you are being suspicious to other NPCs in the game, people will notice, become too suspicious, and the police will start coming after you. Everyday at midnight, an hour between 1:00 and 24:00 will be selected, upon that hour, your home will be searched, if you are in your house? You'll be taken in for questioning. If you've already lied about your wife's location, then make sure not to mess up that lie, because the police are smart, and know to question other people. And those people sure aren't liars.
And what was that about your house being searched? Well don't worry about it. Just make sure to hide your wife in the good harder to find spots, because the more suspicious you are, the more likely they are to check every crevasse of your house. I don't want to give away too much, because I want it to be a challenge, the police aren't idiots, and have some tricks up their sleeves as well.

That's all for now. Good luck future murderers!
-Jeremy.

notes.title: Progress Update: 10/14/21
notes.notes:
[h1]So, what has been going on?[/h1]

Well, since I know that a lot of you do [b]not[/b] use the discord, i've decided to do a little progress update! There's a a lot of news to cover, so I've put it all here, with some exclusive stuff aswell!

[h2]The Demo[/h2]

As you on the discord know, [b][u]the demo has been cancelled[/u][/b], there are various reasons, but the jest of it was that it would represent the game in an unfinished buggy state, and would be a way too big chunk of the game. Hopefully you will see what the game is really like, when it releases.

[h2]The DLC[/h2]

This is exciting, I've just announced [i][b]two brand new, fully fledged CAMPAIGNS![/b][/i], while of course, there's more info on the discord, I'm able to announce the first DLC pack: [b]The Evil Farming Game Replanted: a Cool Cop Adventure in The Big City![/b]

I'll launch the store page when I have screenshots.

[h2]Release Date[/h2]

What many of you would like to know is the release date, when I set a release date, I set expectations for myself, and I have not met the expectations for a specific date, I say October 2021 because I can assume that's when the game will release. But I don't say a day, [i][u]because I don't know when the game will exactly release.[/u][/i] It could release in December! But I assume October, so I'll say October. So we will see, exactly when the game will release.

[h2]Developer Commentary[/h2]

I plan to do a live streamed Developer Commentary on the day of the game's release, so people can see the game being played minutes before the game is released. It wont have too many secrets and spoilers, and it'll just be a simple high score run.
